title: SSU's Alpha special forces take out over 4,300 Russian troops in one week
summary: Special forces of the Alpha Special Operations Center of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) neutralized 4,333 Russian troops in one week.

title: Finland seeking over €25 bln in compensation from Russia and Gazprom
summary: Finland is seeking to recover more than €25 billion from Russia and its state-owned gas producer Gazprom.

title: State Special Transport Service deminers clear over 230,000 hectares of liberated territory
summary: Demining teams from the State Special Transport Service (SSTS) of Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense have surveyed and cleared more than 230,000 hectares of territory liberated from Russian forces.

title: War update: 131 clashes on frontline over past day, most attacks in Pokrovsk direction
summary: A total of 131 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defence Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the frontline on November 21.

title: Russian forces shell nine settlements in Kharkiv region over past day
summary: Russian forces shelled nine settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past 24 hours, causing an elderly woman to suffer an acute stress reaction.

title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region four times in one day
summary: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region four times over the past 24 hours.

title: Lithuania denies involvement in attack on Kaliningrad region following Russian allegations
summary: Lithuania’s National Crisis Management Center (NCMC) has commented on reports by Russian media about an alleged drone in the Kaliningrad region that supposedly entered from Lithuanian territory.

title: Drone attack damages apartment block in Kyiv region, people may be trapped under rubble
summary: A Russian drone attack damaged a five-story residential building in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region, causing a fire.

title: Russian National Guard headquarters in Krasnodar possibly caught fire after drone attack – media
summary: Drones likely struck the Main Directorate of the Russian National Guard (Rosgvardiya) in Russia’s Krasnodar Territory overnight on November 22.

title: Russian strike on enterprise in Chernihiv region sparks fire
summary: A Russian attack caused a fire at an enterprise in the Novhorod-Siverskyi district of the Chernihiv region.

title: Russian forces attack infrastructure facilities in Dnipropetrovsk region
summary: Russian shelling has damaged infrastructure facilities in the Dnipropetrovsk region.

title: Air defenses down 161 of 186 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since evening
summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 161 of the 186 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 21.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,310 over past day
summary: Russia’s total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 22, 2026, have reached approximately 1,637,170 personnel, including 2,310 over the past day.

title: Ukraine preparing to revive Congressional Ukraine caucuses in both Chambers of new US Congress – Chargé d’Affaires
summary: One of the Ukrainian diplomatic service’s top priorities after the new US Congress begins its work on January 3 will be to revive the Ukrainian caucuses in both chambers of the US legislature and arrange bilateral visits between the two countries.

title: Dutch and UK Prime Ministers discuss support for Ukraine during meeting in Amsterdam
summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham discussed support for Ukraine during a meeting in Amsterdam.

title: Residential building damaged in Russian drone attack in Vyshhorod district, residents evacuated
summary: A five-story apartment building was damaged in a Russian drone attack in the Vyshhorod district of the Kyiv region. Rescuers are evacuating residents.

title: UCCA President: New US Congress creates opportunity to boost Ukraine support, but Trump remains key factor
summary: The new composition of the US Congress offers an opportunity to further strengthen American support for Ukraine, but the factor of President Donald Trump must also be taken into account, says Michael Sawkiw Jr., President of the Ukrainian Congress Committee of America (UCCA).

title: Ukrainian border guards down new Russian Filin missile for first time in Chernihiv region
summary: A mobile fire team of the 105th Border Guard Detachment has destroyed a Russian Filin small cruise missile in the Chernihiv region.

title: Ukraine should frame Crimea’s occupation as colonialism to reach the Global South – Useinov
summary: Ukraine should explain the occupation of Crimea to countries of the Global South by drawing on their own historical experience of colonialism. At international forums, this approach could help representatives of those countries better understand what Ukraine is fighting for and explain its position back home.

title: Zelensky names settlements where Ukraine proposes to conduct humanitarian missions
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has named settlements in the Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions where Ukraine proposes conducting humanitarian missions following the successful evacuation of civilians from Oleshky.

title: Light sleet expected in some parts of Ukraine on Sunday, temperatures to range from 0°C to +8°C
summary: Some regions of Ukraine will experience light sleet on Sunday, November 22, while no significant precipitation is expected elsewhere.

title: Melania Trump hopes for new ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia by Christmas
summary: US First Lady Melania Trump has expressed hope that a ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia will be reached by Christmas. She said that negotiations with representatives of both countries are underway.
